title: Hepatitis C Virus and the Humoral Immune System
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to measure specific chemokines, antibodies, and antibody-producing B cells in the blood of patients with hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection. Our hypothesis is that changes in chemokine levels affect the development of an effective immune response against HCV.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy volunteers, no liver disease
* Chronic infection with hepatitis C virus
* Other chronic liver disease unrelated to hepatitis C virus
* Subjects in all groups must have sufficiently healthy veins to allow blood collection.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any medical condition that, in the opinion of the investigators, precludes the patient's participation
study_population: primary care clinics of doctors at NYPH and the NYC metropolitan area
